steps.title: Configure Application Environment
steps.description: Establish target SDK 34, minimum SDK 21, and project configurations using Gradle 8.5 and Android Gradle Plugin 8.3.2.

steps.title: Setup Manifest and XML Schema validation
steps.description: Create the AndroidManifest.xml structure utilizing the correct Android schema namespace, set launcher activity, and declare permissions if any.

steps.title: Design Application Values and Resources
steps.description: Define standard styling values including colors, strings, and custom themes to guarantee a modern Material design.

steps.title: Develop User Interface Structure
steps.description: Create the main screen layout featuring a smooth, horizontal scrollable tab controller to transition between panels (Age Calculator, Compare, Add/Subtract, Saved Profiles, Leap Year).

steps.title: Implement Main Activity Setup
steps.description: Initialize the Android activity, standard fields, panel transition systems, and bind basic layout views with complete click listeners.

steps.title: Create Date Picking Infrastructure
steps.description: Configure the click listeners and native DatePickerDialog setups for user-friendly date-of-birth input selection.

steps.title: Build Age Calculation Engine
steps.description: Develop precise Gregorian-based algorithms to compute exact age (years, months, days) along with standard validation handling.

steps.title: Incorporate Next Birthday Tracker
steps.description: Determine the remaining months and days until the next birth anniversary and identify the upcoming weekday name.

steps.title: Implement Detailed Metrics Generator
steps.description: Construct mathematical functions to calculate overall age equivalents in absolute values (Total Years, Months, Weeks, Days, Hours, Minutes, Seconds).

steps.title: Develop Profile Saving Engine
steps.description: Create a serialization manager using secure local Shared Preferences to allow users to store and delete family and friends' birthdays locally.

steps.title: Implement Secondary Features
steps.description: Implement the core logic for the Age Comparison module, Add/Subtract Dates tool, and the Leap Year validation utility.

steps.title: Building Age Calculator Pro
steps.description: Initiate comprehensive Gradle checks and compilation procedures to output a highly stable, production-ready release package.
